instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Mental health tech company offering an app-based cognitive behavioral therapy program with human therapist chat support. 18,000 active users. Clinical evidence from a published RCT showing 40% reduction in PHQ-9 scores. Expanding into corporate wellness programs and evaluating AI-supported therapist productivity tools. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes. We have substantial resources but also significant organizational inertia — aligning stakeholders across divisions takes deliberate effort and senior executive sponsorship.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. This failure highlighted a lack of internal agility and insufficient user journey mapping prior to development.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.additionalContext: The competitive landscape is increasingly focused on hyper-personalized mental health diagnostics and seamless integration with primary care systems. Recent regulatory shifts regarding AI in clinical decision support present both opportunities for differentiation and significant compliance hurdles that must be managed proactively.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Automated Therapist Workflow Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Given the focus on efficiency and informal process, automating routine administrative tasks for therapists can immediately reduce operational overhead costs. This is a low-risk incremental gain that leverages existing digital maturity to improve staff throughput.

first_actions: Conduct a comprehensive workflow audit across the top 5 therapist roles.
Identify three high-frequency manual tasks suitable for RPA/automation tools.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in administrative overhead per therapist by 15% within 6 months.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Clinical Intervention Model
opportunities.rationale: Developing an AI model to predict patient churn or adverse clinical events before they occur can drastically reduce long-term liability and improve retention. This is a high-impact, balanced risk project that aligns with the need for data-driven efficiency.

first_actions: Define specific clinical endpoints (e.g., predicting 30-day dropout based on usage patterns).
resources_needed: Data science talent acquisition or contract hire (5%)
Cloud computing infrastructure investment for ML training (3%)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a validated predictive accuracy of 75% in identifying high-risk patients.
milestones: Data Labeling and Initial Training: Q2
Pilot Deployment in one clinical unit: Q4

next_steps.action: Formalize a Minimum Viable Process (MVP) for the 'Informal' innovation process.
Allocate specific budget funds ($50k) toward a focused efficiency pilot project.
Conduct talent gap assessment for data science roles essential to the radical intervention model.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal innovation governance and stage-gate process, leading to inconsistent project prioritization.
Reliance on informal processes resulting in high organizational inertia and difficulty aligning cross-divisional stakeholders.
Insufficient internal talent depth in specialized areas like data science needed for advanced efficiency models.
Low budget allocation (10%) relative to enterprise size and competitive pressure, hindering investment in long-term strategic technological shifts.
